name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal landholding farmer families across India
short_description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year distributed in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of eligible landholding farmers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum paid directly in three equal installments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

exclusions: Institutional landholders
Former or present holders of constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, and District Panchayat Chairpersons
Serving or retired officers and employees of central/state government ministries and PSUs
All persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects

required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / Khasra / Land Record RoR)
Active Mobile Number (linked with Aadhaar for OTP e-KYC)

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
hindi_name: आयुष्मान भारत - पीएम-जय (प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना)
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Bottom 40% vulnerable and economically disadvantaged families, and all senior citizens aged 70+
short_description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing a health cover of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year covering pre-existing conditions, diagnostic tests, surgeries, medicines, and intensive care.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Households identified under SECC 2011 deprivation criteria, eligible Ration Card holders (NFSA/BPL), or senior citizens aged 70+ under expanded universal coverage.
exclusions: Government employees covered by CGHS/ECHS/State health schemes
Families owning motorized 3/4 wheelers or mechanized farming equipment
Income tax-paying households

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Certificate or SECC Verification Proof (if applicable)

name: PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Homeless families and households living in kutcha, dilapidated, or temporary houses in rural areas
short_description: Financial assistance to rural homeless and kutcha-house dwelling families to construct a durable pucca house with basic amenities including toilet, LPG, and electricity.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeastern states, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS and ₹12,000 assistance for toilet construction under SBM.

exclusions: Families who already own a pucca house anywhere in India
Households owning motorized 2/3/4 wheeler or motorized fishing boat
Households with any family member as a government employee or income tax payer

required_documents: Bank Account Passbook (with IFSC and DBT linkage)
Consent letter to use Aadhaar data
Photograph of current kutcha house or land site

name: PMAY-U 2.0 (Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Urban)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) families living in statutory urban towns
short_description: Central housing assistance to eligible urban families to construct, purchase, or upgrade to a durable pucca house with interest subsidy or direct financial assistance.
benefits: Direct financial assistance up to ₹2,50,000 or Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) of up to 4% on home loans up to ₹25 Lakhs for 12 years.

exclusions: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name or in the name of any family member across India
Beneficiary family should not have availed central assistance under any prior housing scheme

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Urban Residence Proof (Utility bill, voter card, or lease agreement)
Affidavit of not owning a pucca house

name: PMUY 2.0 (Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_beneficiaries: Adult women from low-income, BPL, SC/ST, and rural households without existing LPG connection
short_description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections along with free first refill cylinder and hotplate/stove to adult women belonging to underprivileged households.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG cylinder connection, free 14.2 kg or 5 kg LPG cylinder refill, free two-burner stove, and recurring targeted government cylinder subsidy.

exclusions: Applicant must be a female adult (18+ years)
There must be NO existing LPG connection in the same household with any Oil Marketing Company (IOCL/BPCL/HPCL)

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of adult female applicant
Ration Card or Family composition certificate
Proof of address (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Ration Card)
Self-declaration of not possessing an LPG connection

name: PMMY (Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises, self-employed individuals, and small shopkeepers
short_description: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 Lakhs (and up to ₹20 Lakhs for seasoned Tarun borrowers) through banks, NBFCs, and MFIs for income-generating micro enterprises.
benefits: Three loan categories without collateral: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000), and Tarun (₹5,00,000 to ₹10,00,000; up to ₹20 Lakhs under Tarun Plus for previous timely repayers). Competitive commercial bank interest rates.

exclusions: Defaults with any scheduled commercial bank or financial institution
Corporate and large business entities

required_documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card / Passport)
Address Proof (Utility bill / Rent agreement / Aadhaar)
Proof of Business Enterprise (Registration certificate / Shop & Establishment license / Udyam Certificate, if existing)
Quotations of machinery or items to be purchased with loan

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools across 18 specified trades
short_description: Comprehensive institutional support to traditional artisans: recognition through Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card, basic/advanced skill training with daily stipend, modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and low-interest collateral-free enterprise credit.
benefits: Skill training with ₹500/day stipend, toolkit grant of ₹15,000, collateral-free credit up to ₹1 Lakh (1st tranche) and ₹2 Lakh (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest rate, and digital transaction incentive.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must be engaged in one of 18 trades (Carpenter, Boat Maker, Blacksmith, Hammer & Tool Maker, Locksmith, Sculptor, Goldsmith, Potter, Cobbler, Mason, Basket/Mat/Broom Maker, Doll & Toy Maker, Barber, Garland Maker, Washerman, Tailor, Fishing Net Maker).
exclusions: Beneficiary or family member having an existing outstanding loan under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra (unless repaid)
Government employees and their immediate family members
Only one member per family is eligible

required_documents: Bank Account details (with IFSC and Aadhaar linkage)
Active Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Ration Card / Proof of family composition

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
hindi_name: पीएम स्वनिधि (प्रधानमंत्री स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Urban and peri-urban street vendors, hawkers, thelewale, and roadside sellers
short_description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable, collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan: 1st loan up to ₹10,000 (1 yr tenure), 2nd loan up to ₹20,000 on prompt repayment, 3rd loan up to ₹50,000. 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, plus cashback up to ₹1,200/year on digital transactions.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Street vendors possessing Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or Recommendation Letter from Town Vending Committee.
exclusions: Non-vendors or large fixed-shop retail businesses

required_documents: Certificate of Vending / ID Card issued by Urban Local Body or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)

name: IGNOAPS (Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - NSAP)
hindi_name: इन्दिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना (एनएसएएपी)
department: Ministry of Rural Development
target_beneficiaries: Destitute and below-poverty-line (BPL) senior citizens aged 60 and above
short_description: Non-contributory monthly social pension to senior citizens living below the poverty line to ensure basic social protection in old age.
benefits: Monthly central pension of ₹200 (for ages 60-79) and ₹500 (for age 80+), supplemented significantly by state government contributions (varying between ₹1,000 to ₹3,000/month depending on state).

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must belong to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL) as per central/state norms.
exclusions: Persons receiving formal occupational or government pensions
Families with taxable income

required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Age verification proof

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
hindi_name: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses
short_description: Centrally sponsored scholarship providing financial assistance towards compulsory non-refundable fees and monthly maintenance allowances to SC/ST students studying in class 11, 12, undergraduate, postgraduate, or professional degrees.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of non-refundable tuition and examination fees plus monthly academic maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/year for hostellers and ₹7,000/year for day scholars).

exclusions: Employed students drawing full salary
Students enrolled in non-recognized unaccredited institutions
Family income exceeding ₹2,50,000 per annum

required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Current Academic Year Fee Receipt & Student ID Card
Bank Account Passbook in student's own name

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance / SIDBI
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs and SC/ST individuals setting up greenfield (new) business enterprises
short_description: Bank loan facility between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore covering up to 85% of project cost for manufacturing, services, agri-allied activities, or trading sector, with concessional interest rates and credit guarantee cover.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must be either a Woman OR belong to SC/ST category. In non-individual enterprises, at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake must be held by an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.
exclusions: Defaults with any scheduled commercial bank or financial institution
Existing operating enterprises (must be a greenfield project)

required_documents: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card)
Caste Certificate (if applying under SC/ST quota)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash-flow projection
Proof of business premises / lease deed
Bank Account details and ITR / Net worth proof

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens in unorganized sector aged 18 to 40 years
short_description: Government-backed guaranteed voluntary pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector to secure guaranteed monthly income in retirement.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month starting at age 60, depending on monthly contribution. In case of subscriber's demise, spouse receives pension; subsequently, full accumulated corpus is returned to nominee.

exclusions: Any citizen who is or has been an Income Tax Payer on or after 1st October 2022
Applicants younger than 18 or older than 40 years at entry

required_documents: Active Savings Bank Account or Post Office Savings Account

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged 18 to 70 holding an active bank account
short_description: Ultra-affordable annual government personal accident insurance providing coverage against accidental death and permanent disability.
benefits: Risk coverage of ₹2 Lakhs in case of accidental death or permanent total disability, and ₹1 Lakh for permanent partial disability. Annual premium is just ₹20 per year auto-debited from bank account.

exclusions: Individuals aged below 18 or above 70 years
Non-holders of savings bank accounts

required_documents: Bank Account details with auto-debit consent form

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Department of Posts / Ministry of Finance (Beti Bachao Beti Padhao)
target_beneficiaries: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child below 10 years of age
short_description: High-interest government small savings scheme designed to secure future higher education and marriage expenses for girl children.
benefits: Attractive government-guaranteed interest rate (~8.2% p.a., compounded annually), tax exemption under Section 80C, tax-free interest, and tax-free maturity proceeds (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt). Account matures upon completion of 21 years or upon marriage after age 18.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Account can be opened by parents/guardians for a girl child from her birth till she attains 10 years of age. Maximum of two accounts per family (triplets/twins exceptions apply).
exclusions: Girl child age exceeds 10 years at account opening
Male child is not eligible

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar Card and PAN of the parent/legal guardian
Passport size photographs of child and guardian

name: PMKVY 4.0 (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) / NSDC
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed Indian youth, school/college dropouts, and candidates seeking industry-aligned vocational skills
short_description: Flagship skill certification scheme offering free short-term industry 4.0 training, soft skills, digital literacy, and placement support.
benefits: Completely free NSQF-aligned skill training courses, government recognized certification, assessment monetary reward, digital literacy module, and placement assistance through Rozgar Melas.

exclusions: Candidates already enrolled in full-time regular government degree courses with active full attendance requirement

name: PMMSY (Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana)
department: Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_beneficiaries: Fishers, fish farmers, fisheries cooperatives, SHGs, and youth involved in aquaculture
short_description: Umbrella scheme for sustainable development of fisheries sector providing massive subsidies for fish ponds, biofloc units, modern fishing vessels, and cold storage chains.
benefits: Financial assistance and capital subsidy of 40% of project cost for General category and 60% for Women, SC, and ST beneficiaries across hatcheries, aquaculture units, and cold chains.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must possess suitable land or water body (owned or leased for at least 7-10 years) for aquaculture/fisheries activities.
exclusions: Defaults with institutional banking bodies

required_documents: Land Ownership Documents or Registered Lease Agreement for water body

name: NAPS (National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme)
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
target_beneficiaries: Youth with minimum education (Class 5, 8, 10, 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduate) seeking paid on-the-job industrial apprenticeship
short_description: Promotes apprenticeship training across Indian industrial establishments by providing direct government stipend sharing to youth during training.
benefits: Government co-funds 25% of prescribed monthly stipend up to ₹1,500/month directly to apprentice via DBT, alongside industrial hands-on exposure and National Apprenticeship Certificate.

exclusions: Candidates below 14 years of age (18 years for hazardous industries)
Candidates currently enrolled in full-time school without flexibility for on-site apprenticeship

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Girl children permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh in low-income families
short_description: State-specific conditional cash transfer scheme in Uttar Pradesh providing phased financial assistance across 6 stages from birth through graduation to promote education and prevent female foeticide.
benefits: Total financial grant of ₹25,000 paid across 6 stages: Birth (₹5,000), 1 yr vaccinations (₹2,000), Class 1 admission (₹3,000), Class 6 admission (₹3,000), Class 9 admission (₹5,000), and Degree/Diploma admission (₹7,000).

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Family must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh with annual family income not exceeding ₹3,00,000. Maximum of two girl children per family.
exclusions: Non-residents of Uttar Pradesh
Families with annual income exceeding ₹3,00,000

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of girl child and parents
Admission proof / School Certificate for relevant stage
Joint Bank Account passbook with mother/guardian

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
hindi_name: कलैग्नार मगलीर उरीमई थिट्टम (तमिलनाडु महिला अधिकार योजना)
department: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Eligible women heads of families residing in Tamil Nadu
short_description: Pioneering universal basic income assistance scheme in Tamil Nadu recognizing the unpaid labour of women homemakers by providing unconditional monthly cash support.
benefits: Direct monthly financial grant of ₹1,000 credited directly into the bank accounts of women heads of households (₹12,000 per year).

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Family annual income below ₹2,50,000, holding less than 5 acres of wetland or 10 acres of dry land, and annual household electricity consumption under 3,600 units.
exclusions: Non-residents of Tamil Nadu
Families with income tax payers or GST registered businesses
Families of regular government employees and pensioners
Families owning four-wheeler cars/SUVs (excluding commercial vehicles like autos/taxis)

required_documents: Tamil Nadu Smart Ration Card (Family Card)
Aadhaar Card of female head of family

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Rajasthan)
department: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed graduate youth native to Rajasthan
short_description: Unemployment allowance and skill enhancement scheme in Rajasthan providing monthly stipends to educated unemployed graduate youth with 4 hours daily internship.
benefits: Monthly allowance of ₹4,000 for male graduate candidates and ₹4,500 for female, transgender, and specially-abled (PwD) candidates for up to 2 years or until employment.

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must be a bona fide resident of Rajasthan, possessing a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university. Age limit relaxed up to 35 years for SC/ST/PwD/Women. Requires 3-month skill course and 4-hour daily government department internship.
exclusions: Non-residents of Rajasthan
Non-graduates or candidates currently pursuing full-time regular master's course
Candidates already in gainful private or government employment
Family income exceeding ₹2,00,000 per year

required_documents: Rajasthan Bonafide Domicile Certificate (Mool Niwas Praman Patra)
Aadhaar Card and Jan Aadhaar Card
